# Liquid Cooling, High-Density Architectures, and Technology Cooling Systems (TCS) {#sec-liquid-cooling-tcs}

## Worked Example: Direct-to-Chip ($\Delta T$) Volumetric Flow Rate & Pipe Sizing

The thermodynamic relationship governing the fluid mass flow rate ($\dot{m}$) required to remove heat from the white space is [@ref22_reliabilityengine_liquid]:

$$Q = \dot{m} C_p \Delta T$$ {#eq-heat-rejection}

Converting mass flow into volumetric flow rate ($\dot{V}$) in liters per second ($\text{L/s}$), accounting for fluid density ($\rho$):

$$\dot{V} = \frac{Q}{\rho C_p \Delta T}$$ {#eq-volumetric-flow}

In a direct-to-chip architecture with a design temperature difference of $\Delta T = 10\text{ K}$ using a standard 25% propylene glycol solution (PG25: $\rho \approx 1020\text{ kg/m}^3$, $C_p \approx 3.93\text{ kJ/(kg}\cdot\text{K)}$), the volumetric flow rate per megawatt ($1000\text{ kW}$) of critical IT heat load is:

$$\dot{V} = \frac{1000\text{ kW}}{1.02\text{ kg/L} \times 3.93\text{ kJ/(kg}\cdot\text{K)} \times 10\text{ K}} \approx 24.95\text{ L/s} \quad (1497\text{ L/min})$$ {#eq-pg25-10k}

```{python}
#| label: tbl-dtc-flow-calculator
#| tbl-cap: "Interactive Python Calculator: Volumetric Flow Rate and Header Pipe Bore vs. Design Delta-T (1 MW IT Load, PG25)"

import math

def dtc_flow_calculator(it_load_kw=1000.0, delta_t_k=10.0, rho_kg_m3=1020.0, cp_kj_kg_k=3.93, max_vel_m_s=2.4):
    rho_kg_l = rho_kg_m3 / 1000.0
    v_dot_l_s = it_load_kw / (rho_kg_l * cp_kj_kg_k * delta_t_k)
    v_dot_l_min = v_dot_l_s * 60.0
    l_min_per_kw = v_dot_l_min / it_load_kw
    # Standard Sch 10S SS316L pipes (DN, ID_mm)
    pipes = [(50, 54.79), (65, 66.93), (80, 82.80), (100, 108.20), (125, 134.50), (150, 161.46)]
    selected_dn, actual_vel = pipes[-1][0], 0.0
    for dn, id_mm in pipes:
        area_m2 = math.pi * ((id_mm / 1000.0) / 2.0) ** 2
        vel = (v_dot_l_s / 1000.0) / area_m2
        if vel <= max_vel_m_s:
            selected_dn, actual_vel = dn, vel
            break
    return v_dot_l_s, v_dot_l_min, l_min_per_kw, selected_dn, actual_vel

print(f"{'Delta-T (K)':<12} | {'Flow (L/s)':<12} | {'Flow (L/min)':<14} | {'L/min/kW':<10} | {'Header DN':<10} | {'Velocity (m/s)'}")
print("-" * 78)
for dt in [10.0, 15.0, 20.0]:
    v_ls, v_lmin, l_kw, dn, vel = dtc_flow_calculator(1000.0, dt)
    print(f"{dt:<12.1f} | {v_ls:<12.2f} | {v_lmin:<14.1f} | {l_kw:<10.2f} | DN{dn:<8} | {vel:.2f}")
```
